one_liner: All-in-one funnel builder and marketing platform (email, courses, funnels); offers a public REST API.

auth.notes: Web search summary: 'To authenticate with the Systeme.io Public API, you need to attach your API key to the X-API-Key header of each request.' Page not directly fetched for a verbatim quote within call budget; quote left null pending pass-2.

access.notes: API keys are generated directly from account dashboard profile settings ('Public API keys' section, up to 3 keys per account); systeme.io has a free plan. No OAuth documented, so third-party (on-behalf-of-others) integration is not natively supported -- each customer would need to share their own API key.

api.notes: Did not fetch the OpenAPI reference directly within call budget to count endpoints; likely a smaller/narrow API given the product's scope.

verdict.rationale: Free-plan users can self-generate a static API key from their dashboard with no review gate, though there is no OAuth flow for acting on other users' accounts.
